title: Signal Bridge: unify dependency notifications, SLA mapping & cutover runbook
creator: Sana Patel
description:
Objective: Create a lightweight, opinionated 'Signal Bridge' that standardizes how teams (Eng, Design, Security, Infra) report and consume roadmap dependency signals. The bridge will: 1) normalize notifications (status changes, blockers, cutover windows) into a canonical event format; 2) map dependency signals to SLA tiers and escalation paths; 3) provide a cutover/playbook template surfaced in Console and linked to Linear; 4) emit telemetry to the Roadmap Dependency dashboard for trend analysis and automated readiness gates.

Scope: Phase 1 (MVP) focuses on onboarding the following flows: rollout readiness (canary -> general), Dedicated capacity infra changes, Private deployment upgrades (VPC), and cross-team design handoffs. The MVP will include a webhook-based ingest, a transformation layer (rules authored by PMs), and a small Console widget showing current critical dependency score per initiative.

Success metrics (Target within 8 weeks):
- 90% of cross-team dependency state changes are visible in the Signal Bridge within 30 minutes of update.
- Mean time to identify and route a cutover blocker to the owning team reduced from 18h to <4h.
- Teams using the playbook report the cutover checklist reduced time-to-ready by at least 25%.

Non-goals: Full automation of remediation, replacing service-level incident tooling, or expanding to external partner vendors in Phase 1.

Why now: We observed repeated handoff friction during runtime-1.18 rollout and Dedicated autoscaling redesign (see incident notes). Current signals are spread across Slack channels, ad-hoc PR checklists, and individual Dashboards. A single canonical signal pipeline will reduce cognitive load and enable measurable readiness gates tied to roadmap commitments.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical event schema documented and published in Confluence
Webhook connector deployed that ingests Linear/PR/console events and normalizes them
Console widget shows per-initiative dependency score and last blocker update
Escalation playbook templates (PM -> Eng -> Security -> Infra) available and linked from initiative pages
Two cross-functional teams onboarded and observed for one release cycle (Dedicated + Private)
